decisions.reason: 詳細說明 Wireshark 顯示過濾器，可篩選已擷取封包。
decisions.evidence: Wireshark provides a display filter language that enables you to precisely control which packets are displayed.

decisions.reason: 提供依指定 IP 位址顯示來源或目的封包的具體語法。
decisions.evidence: to only display packets to or from the IP address 192.168.0.1, use ip.addr==192.168.0.1

decisions.reason: 說明記錄 TLS 金鑰並在 Wireshark 設定金鑰檔以解密封包的流程。
decisions.evidence: You can specify the key file path in Wireshark via Edit -> Preferences -> Protocols -> TLS -> (Pre)-Master-Secret log filename .

decisions.reason: 內容為 TLS 工作階段金鑰記錄與解密，未說明代理 CA 安裝或用戶端信任設定。
decisions.evidence: The SSL/TLS master keys can be logged by mitmproxy so that external programs can decrypt SSL/TLS connections both from and to the proxy.
